name: 100x-search-query
author: 100x
summary: Product/persona card in -> Pinterest/TikTok/Reddit search-phrase bundle out, for sourcing visual references and content inspiration.

validation.structural_and_per_item: schema.json (JSON Schema draft-07) -- enforces bucket size, q ASCII pattern, intent_cn format+length, stage enum. This is everything vanilla JSON Schema CAN express.
validation.cross_item_aggregate: scripts/validate.js -- the real, runnable enforcement of axiom 2 (per-bucket keyword density), axiom 3 (5A stage coverage across all 45 items), axiom 5 (persona-informed coverage when meta.persona_informed is true), and the sensitive-category content-policy check, none of which schema.json can express. Loads schema.json at runtime for the stage enum + intent_cn pattern so the two files can't silently drift. Run 'node scripts/validate.js --selftest' for the built-in regression suite (13 checks: 2 real evals/ files, the 'all items stage:Advocate' counterexample, a zero-density Pinterest counterexample, 2 sensitive-category counterexamples, 2 ajv structural-enforcement regressions (additionalProperties/enum), 4 sensitive-category bypass-class regressions, and 2 axiom-5 regressions).
validation.content_policy: workflow.md Phase 1 step 6: if category/product_name/source copy hits BOTH a sensitive-category signal (adult/two-sex-health category words, incl. common euphemisms/near-synonyms) AND an authority-claim signal (fda/certified/doctor-endorsed words, incl. near-synonyms) at the same time, generation still proceeds but meta.warnings MUST carry a specific notice. scripts/validate.js re-checks this against the ENTIRE output bundle's text (category + product_name + all q + all intent_cn) for BOTH signals as a second line of defense. KNOWN, NOT FULLY CLOSED limitations (disclosed in workflow.md/SKILL.md, not hidden): (a) fixed keyword-list check, not semantic -- any rephrasing outside the expanded word lists still evades it; (b) still cannot see raw source input text that never surfaces in category/product_name/q/intent_cn. Phase 1 (which does see raw input) remains the first line of defense; this script is the second, imperfect one.

input_contract.class_a_note: category is the only field the USER must actually supply -- missing it triggers a hard reject+re-ask (workflow.md Phase 1 step 2). product_name is required in schema.json's OUTPUT contract (must be a non-empty string) but is NOT required as user input: if the user can't give a real brand/product name, workflow.md Phase 1 fills a '[品类锚点] <category>' placeholder and proceeds normally.
input_contract.note: This repo does not yet have a shared cross-skill input schema (schemas/ is empty). Input is described informally here and in workflow.md Phase 1, not enforced by a separate input JSON Schema file.

requires_data_note: Not runtime dependencies -- this skill is purely generative and does not query a corpus at inference time. 'corpus.labeled_transcripts' records that the axioms/workflow were validated against a multi-language reference transcript corpus (EN + ES). No corpus content is stored in this repo. 'taxonomy.category_generic' is the generic category enum referenced in workflow.md Phase 1 (this repo's taxonomies/ directory is not populated yet -- TODO).

methodology_origin.adaptation_summary: Self-contained implementation of the search query generation methodology. Cleaned of external dependencies. Schema and validation rules are self-contained.

language_scope.output_language: en-only, no exceptions (axioms.md #1) -- output must satisfy schema.json's ASCII-only q pattern.
language_scope.input_language: source product copy may be in any language; tested across multi-lingual inputs (EN and ES); output language is unaffected

eval_policy: evals/ contains synthetic/fictional products only. No real transcript text, account name, product name, or Feishu link may appear in this skill's files.
